esports.filters.title: Server notification filters
esports.filters.rules: Values of the same kind are combined with **OR**, different kinds with **AND**. A team filter passes if either team is selected. VRS Top-N passes if at least one team is reliably matched within the top N; if VRS data is missing the filter **stops notifications**. Personal follows never widen these filters.

esports.roles.title: Notification roles
esports.roles.explain: Making a role a ping target and letting members assign it to themselves are separate decisions. Self-service roles must grant no extra permissions and must not open private channels.
